messages.subject: Garrety - reference requests
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

We've had a reference request for David from a recruiter. I take it we just use the agreed wording in Schedule 2 of the settlement agreement and respond consistently to any oral enquiries?

Yvette Marsh
HR Director, Pennington Industries Limited
